recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire to restore a MedicinalProductDefinition.package backbone should be handled by revisiting FHIR-31859/FHIR-31782 or opening a new tracker, not by treating FHIR-31596 as incompletely applied.
issue_request: FHIR-31596 was a Published FHIR-core BR&R change request resolved as Persuasive for R5. It asked to replace MedicinalProductDefinition.packagedMedicinalProduct with a repeatable MedicinalProductDefinition.package backbone containing type, size[x] Quantity|integer, and a package Reference to PackagedProductDefinition.
initial_application: Commit 568677234571883603b9e0001acb394e271a40aa explicitly applied FHIR#31596 by removing packagedMedicinalProduct and adding the requested package backbone. Commit aa2f228c821b96e4c0fc79e1c815d97ce6997050 later removed the package.package reference and integer size option while applying FHIR-31859, and commit 5d196f882b51cf9548321a5819882de30fdfe2c4 removed the remaining package backbone and restored packagedMedicinalProduct while applying FHIR-31782.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition as active current-build resources. Current source has MedicinalProductDefinition.packagedMedicinalProduct as a CodeableConcept, no MedicinalProductDefinition.package backbone, and no MedicinalProductDefinition targetProfile to PackagedProductDefinition. Current PackagedProductDefinition.packageFor is the full-package link back to MedicinalProductDefinition. FHIR-31859 and FHIR-31782 are already represented on the combined branch and were used only as later/superseding context here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the FHIR-31596 package backbone would contradict later approved no-bidirectional-link and backbone-removal decisions, so the current source is correct without edits.
